title: Admission-gated terminal SceneSpec to immutable BuildPlan to Blender scene compilation
question: Can the exact admitted B62 Phase 0 master and exact D6 motion-camera evidence be expressed as a narrow ScenePackageSpec, deterministically compiled into one immutable BuildPlan, applied by real Blender 5.2 without rendering, and independently reopened with only the authorized camera/action/marker delta?
claimScope: B62-specific precompiled scene-package dialect; this is a terminal production bridge, not a general SceneSpec v0.6 implementation.

buildPlanContract.determinism: Compile the admitted ScenePackageSpec twice in separate Node processes; canonical JSON bytes and SHA-256 must be exact.
buildPlanContract.sourceBinding: Bind the exact source master, Phase 0 receipt/audit/generation and D6 build/receipt/audit/human-review file hashes plus self hashes.

camera.name: CAM_CLOSE_MOTION_TERMINAL
camera.sampleSource: Copy only frame, motionLocation and motionQuaternion from the exact D6 build in ascending frame order. No recomputation, smoothing or threshold reuse is authorized.

buildPlanContract.authorizedDelta: Add exactly one camera object, one camera datablock and one seven-curve action; reroute only SHOT_CLOSE_REFLECTION; preserve all prior IDs and state; save a new blend.
buildPlanContract.immutability: BuildPlan is created with exclusive creation, contains a self hash, and is never modified or overwritten after admission.

realBlenderProtocol.compiler: Start Blender 5.2 with factory startup and auto-exec disabled, open the exact master, reject runtime or source drift, apply only the BuildPlan-authorized delta, save scene/B62_TERMINAL_PRODUCTION.blend, write a self-hashed compile report, and perform zero renders.
realBlenderProtocol.independentAuditor: A separate fresh Blender process reopens only the derived scene, independently verifies the exact 96-frame camera pose at tolerance 1e-6, marker routing, timeline, render/color contract, object/data/action deltas, asset identities, source-camera preservation, motion/contact/core/light preservation, and zero render calls.
realBlenderProtocol.nodeAuditor: Independently recompute file identities, BuildPlan canonical hash, process/resource accounting, root roster, Blender reports, acceptance gates and mutation attacks; write outcome-neutral audit and receipt with self hashes.

forbidden: reuse of any derived scene or formal output root

sequence: Commit and push this experiment spec, protocol, input ScenePackageSpec and journal while all five tools and the formal root are absent.
Implement and statically validate exact tool bytes without creating the formal root or starting Blender.
Commit and push exact tool bytes.
Run from the fresh immutable root, retain every failure, and require a separately preregistered correction plus a new root after any failure.

output.immutableFailurePolicy: Any failure preserves the entire partial root. No output is overwritten, reused or silently repaired.

decision.supportedWhen: All 20 acceptance gates and all 12 mutation attacks pass under the exact admitted runtime and budgets.
decision.invalidated: Any parent, path, tool, runtime, determinism, compile, preservation, independent-reopen, process, resource, roster or receipt failure yields status FAIL and scientificVerdict null.

nextAuthorization: A supported T1 authorizes only a separately preregistered 288-frame low-cost animatic/full-timeline audit of the compiled scene. It does not authorize the final 288-frame Cycles render by itself.
nonClaims: This experiment does not prove a universal SceneSpec v0.6 or import arbitrary user assets.
This experiment does not render or inspect any new image and therefore does not prove temporal image continuity, final-film quality or delivery encoding.
This experiment does not test interruption/restart of the final render job.
The Phase 0 assets remain stylized diagnostic assets; preserving them does not establish photorealism.
